subtitle: Read, edit and review one saved reply
description: A connected-app sample for Gmail. Read messages, edit one saved reply with your app agent, and request native exact-message review. Includes fictional offline fixtures and a quiet incoming-email peer workflow. Local tests cover UI and connector safety; live OAuth, model processing and phone sending remain unverified.
release_notes: Development sample. Local editing and connector safety tests; no live-service release claim.
